T. 索费尔先生绑架案。

pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S.B. REGISTRY
v. D 3820
"A" 6 / 7 / 32
Central / /
10.11.32.

CONFIDENTIAL.
1845/31.

Extensive, but discreet, enquiries were made by
D.S. Beloshenko and the undersigned with a view to ascertain
the origination of the gang of the Russian kidnappers and
the grounds as to why Mr. T. Sopher was picked out as a
prospective victim.

As no definite conclusion could be gained from the
prisoners statements, discreet enquiries were carried out
by the Detectives on the case among the people of various
walk in life.

It would appear that either Kwantseladze organized
the gang and whilst looking for a suitable victim, met an
informant in the person of Romanoff, or, Romanoff for some
or other reason desired Mr. Sopher to be kidnapped and
engaged for that purpose Kwantseladze, but, in any case,
Romanoff appear to be the central figure in the conspiracy.

His career shows him not to be a daring organizer
of kidnapping bands, but a common swindler and card-sharper.

There was no direct evidence that there were any
persons behind him, but such a notion might be admissible.
Therefore thorough enquiries were made regarding the
persons with whom he was in contact during the period of
three or four months previous to his arrest and whether or
not among them there were any ill-wishers to Mr. Sopher.

The following is the result of the enquiries, which
is forwarded for what it is worth.

机密
卷宗柜
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
v. D 3820
"A" 6 / 7 / 32
中央 / /
1932年11月10日。

机密。
1845/31号。

侦探长别洛申科（Beloshenko）及具名者进行了广泛而谨慎的调查，旨在查明该俄罗斯绑架团伙的起源，以及 T. 索费尔先生被选为潜在受害者的原因。

由于从囚犯的供词中无法得出确切结论，负责此案的侦探在各阶层人士中进行了谨慎的调查。

情况似乎是，要么是由克万采拉泽（Kwantseladze）组织了该团伙，并在寻找合适受害者时遇到了作为线人的罗曼诺夫（Romanoff）；要么是罗曼诺夫出于某种原因希望索费尔先生被绑架，并为此雇佣了克万采拉泽。但无论如何，罗曼诺夫似乎是阴谋中的核心人物。

他的经历表明，他并非大胆的绑架团伙组织者，而是一个普通的骗子和牌场老千。

没有直接证据表明他背后有任何人指使，但这种推测是可能成立的。因此，对其被捕前三四个月期间接触的人员进行了彻底调查，以查明其中是否有人对索费尔先生怀有恶意。

以下是调查结果，仅供参考。

pages.en:
(2)

It was learned that Romanoff on arriving at Shanghai
in December 1930, joined the staff of the Polish Club, 100,
Route des Soeurs as the Card Room Manager, and about April
1931 he obtained the similar position with the Rectors Club,
situated in Route Doumer, which was run by a certain Mr.
H.E. Booker. Whilst with the Rectors Club, Romanoff was
constantly seen in company of Mr. Booker, going to cabarets
together and often visiting Booker at his home.

Regarding Booker, it was said, that he had reasons to
feel animosity towards Sophers.

It appears that some time ago Sophers were offered by
him to take a share in the promotion of the re-established
"Luna Park" and they agreed, but at the last moment with-
drew, thereby causing to Booker much annoyance in searching
for other investors and so retarding the enterprise.
Then in August Booker again offered to Sophers to invest
$100,000.00 for opening a fashionable night club, in
company with the former owner of the "Plaza Hotel", generally
known as "Big Ben". After lengthly negotiations Sophers
refrained from taking part in this enterprise, fearing same
to grow into a "wheel-house". It was said, that in some
private conversation they spoke of Booker as a "roulette-
runner" and this, eventually, became known to Booker, who
then considered himself to have been grossly abused and
was extremely embittered against Sophers.

Further it was learned, that Booker was very intimate
with a Mr. Judah, who used to regularly visit the Rectors
Club, but never played cards there, passing the time in
conversations with Booker.
pages.zh:
(2)

据悉，罗曼诺夫于1930年12月抵达上海后，加入霞飞路（Route des Soeurs）100号波兰俱乐部的职员队伍，担任牌室经理；约在1931年4月，他在杜美路（Route Doumer）的雷克特斯俱乐部（Rectors Club）获得了类似的职位，该俱乐部由一位名叫 H.E. 布克（H.E. Booker）的先生经营。在雷克特斯俱乐部任职期间，人们经常看到罗曼诺夫与布克先生在一起，一同前往歌舞厅，并常去布克家中拜访。

关于布克，据说他有理由对索费尔一家感到敌意。

看来，前一段时间布克曾邀请索费尔一家入股重新开办的“月园”（Luna Park），他们起初同意，但在最后一刻退出，导致布克在寻找其他投资者时颇感烦恼，从而延误了该企业的发展。随后在八月，布克再次向索费尔一家提议投资100,000.00美元，与俗称“大本”（Big Ben）的前“普拉萨酒店”（Plaza Hotel）所有者共同开设一家时尚夜总会。经过 lengthy 谈判，索费尔一家因担心该企业演变为“轮盘赌窝点”而拒绝参与。据说，他们在某些私人谈话中称布克为“轮盘赌经营者”，这话最终传到了布克耳中，他认为自己受到了严重侮辱，因而对索费尔一家极度怨恨。

此外还获悉，布克与一位朱达（Judah）先生关系非常密切，朱达经常光顾雷克特斯俱乐部，但从不在此打牌，只是与布克聊天消磨时间。

pages.en:
(3)

About Judah, it is so far known, that he lives in
Avenue Joffre near Route Pichon. He is a nephew of late
Mr. Ezra, who was married to Sopher's sister. It is said,
that owing to Judah's having mortgaged or somehow mishandled
some of the late Mr. Ezra's property, there was so great a
quarrel between him and the Sophers, that Sophers gave up
their house, which was next to that of Judah's and removed
to their present address. Even now they don't recognize
each other.

It was also said that Judah is on very good terms with
the persons who were expected to be the trustees of the
Hardoon's legacy and who were unexpectedly supplanted by
the Sophers.

D.S.134.
pages.zh:
(3)

关于朱达，目前所知的是，他居住在靠近毕勋路（Route Pichon）的霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）。他是已故以斯拉（Ezra）先生的侄子，而以斯拉先生娶了索费尔的姐妹。据说，由于朱达抵押或以某种方式不当处理了已故以斯拉先生的部分财产，他与索费尔一家发生了极大的争吵，以致索费尔一家放弃了紧邻朱达住所的房屋，搬至目前的地址。即便现在，双方仍互不理睬。

另据称，朱达与本应成为哈同（Hardoon）遗产受托人的人士关系良好，但这些人士意外地被索费尔一家所取代。

侦探长 134号。
